## Contract review brief — PR #36021 @ `a05ec513040fe60fb2518e50b3490386e1d0b792` (card #35678)

You review at `TIER_DEFAULT`. Render ONE `## Contract review` record on this head — its shape is
`node scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs --template --face declaration` — with a PASS or FAIL verdict, and post it as ONE comment
on the PR or its card.

Inputs — these and nothing else:
  · card #35678: its body and EVERY comment (rulings and earlier records included)
  · PR #36021: its body, its file list, and the net diff against `main` at `a05ec513040fe60fb2518e50b3490386e1d0b792`
  · the check-runs on `a05ec513040fe60fb2518e50b3490386e1d0b792`: their conclusions ARE the gate verdicts
⛔ Not the dispatch order, ⛔ not the dispatching seat's own conclusions — this brief is adversarial by design.

⛔ READ-ONLY. No worktree, no checkout, no build, no test run, no gate re-run, no ablation: the check-runs
   on the head already answered every derived gate family, and a local run costs more than it returns.
   If ONE probe is unavoidable, the record's `Local-runs:` line says `probe — REASON`; otherwise `none`.
   Scratch space is `/tmp/claude-0/-home-user/3d3cbaf6-4903-5fed-92d4-c2b94a45e868/scratchpad/pr-36021/` alone; nothing there you did not write this round is read.

Judge, in the record's own sections:
  ① Derived judgments — every accept-set and public-surface change the diff implies, each named right or wrong.
  ② Semver level — the changeset (or `skip-changeset`) matches what the diff publishes, and the `Clause-②:` line.
  ③ Boundary flags — every dev flag and every `open_questions` entry answered, or escalated.
     On every face, SQL push-down: a new id materialisation or in-app join where SQL could push down is a
     finding unless a reason is given (AGENTS.md, Prime Directive 5: SQL first).
Sign `Implemented-by:` with the dev's branch and `Reviewed-by:` with your session id — the value is the FIRST
thing after each colon.

Seat addition: `@object-ui/plugin-grid`'s index drops `useListPageBarHost` and `ListPageBarState`; the changeset calls them unpublished. They came with #35637 (merged 2026-11-19), after the last plugin-grid version bump (#33849, 2026-11-18, 18.6.0). Judge in ② whether their removal is a narrowing of any PUBLISHED declaration, or only of unreleased ones, and say so explicitly; if published, the verdict is FAIL with the face corrected to narrowing.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `a05ec513040fe60fb2518e50b3490386e1d0b792`
Local-runs: none

Inputs read: card #35678 (body as rewritten 2026-11-20T23:00Z and all 7 comments, claim 7058449261 governing), PR #36021 (body, 31-file list, net diff `origin/main...pr-36021`, merge base `b89f1b5f`), and the 62 check-runs on this head: 52 success, 10 skipped (opt-in or path-filtered: UI Published Artifacts, Temporal Conformance, Packed-tarball smoke, 18.x upgrade harness, Build Docs, Dogfood Verify CLI and the dogfood matrix, the three queue-verdict jobs), 0 failure. The face is the declaration face: no published-schema or governed path in the tree (Governed Surface Queue Guard success on this head), and the PR body and changeset both read `Clause-②: yes (widening)`.

### ① Derived judgments

Every public-surface and accept-set change the diff implies, judged against the published `18.6.0` trees (version commit `958ee0359`, #33849):

- **`@object-ui/plugin-grid` index, net against 18.6.0** — additions only: `useListPageScope` (new), and `readListScrollState` / `ListScrollState` (unreleased, from #35637, untouched here). `BulkActionBar`, `BulkActionBarProps`, `BulkActionItems`, `LegacyBulkActionItem`, `useBulkActionItems`, `resolveBulkActions` all keep their published names; `BulkActionBar` and `BulkActionBarProps` now come from `components/SelectionBar.tsx`, the two item types still from `components/BulkActionBar.tsx`. The package has one export entry (`.` plus `./style.css`), so no deep import of `SelectionPageBar.tsx` or `listPageBarSlot.ts` was ever reachable. Right.
- **`BulkActionBarProps`** — compared member by member with 18.6.0: every member is kept with the same type and optionality, plus one optional `singleRowMenu?: RowActionMenuProps`. A widening. Right.
- **`BulkActionBar` render** — the published component no longer draws the full-width strip, the cross-page banner (`bulk-cross-page-banner`) or the text "Clear" button. It draws a self-contained pill with ×, the count chip and the "Select all N" offer. This is a change in how the component looks, not in its declaration. No in-repo consumer outside plugin-grid renders it: `ObjectFormCanvas.tsx` has its own local function of that name, and `ListView` draws its own strip for non-grid views. The changeset says the component is redrawn. Right.
- **Module-internal exports** — `BulkActionButton` loses its `size` prop, and `RowActionInlineButton` gains `buttonClassName`. Neither one is on the package index, in 18.6.0 or on this head. No public effect. Right.
- **`@object-ui/types` `DataTableSchema.floatingBar?: React.ReactNode`** — an optional member on the TypeScript interface. A widening, pinned in `data-table-declared-keys-6882.test.ts`. Right.
- **zod twin `DataTableSchema.floatingBar: handlerKeyRefusal(..., 'runtime-slot', ...)`** — an accept-set change: in 18.6.0 the passthrough `BaseSchema.extend` kept an authored `floatingBar`, and nothing read it. Now it is refused by name. No declared capability is taken away, because no renderer read the key before this PR. This follows the `summaryRow` precedent from #35548, which used the same helper, joined the same `KnownDrift` entry and shipped with `Metadata-protocol: none`. The `KnownDrift` ledger count is updated (51 entries, 90 → 91 keys). Right, with nit F2 on the refusal's wording.
- **`@object-ui/components` `data-table`** — reads `floatingBar`, draws a spacer row (`data-table-floating-bar-room`) and a zero-height sticky anchor after the scroll box. No export or prop change outside the schema member above. Right.
- **`@object-ui/app-shell` `objectViewPageHeader.tsx`** — `ObjectViewPageHeader` and `ObjectViewBarTrailing` keep their signatures. The selection face and its `list-selection-page-bar` testid are removed inside them. This matches card items 4 and 8. Right.
- **Metadata protocol** — nothing a metadata author can write is added, retired or changed in meaning; `floatingBar` is a host-only runtime slot. `Metadata-protocol: none` is right.

### ② Semver level

- `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, on both the PR body and the changeset, is right. Against the published 18.6.0 declarations, the diff adds a new export (`useListPageScope`), a new optional prop (`singleRowMenu`) and a new optional schema member (`floatingBar`). It removes nothing that was published.
- **Seat question: is the removal of `useListPageBarHost` / `ListPageBarState` the narrowing of a published declaration?** No. It narrows only unreleased declarations. The evidence:
  - `listPageBarSlot.ts` first appears in `d96c878e3` (#35637, merged 2026-11-19 21:19Z). That commit descends from the plugin-grid version bump `958ee0359` (#33849, 2026-11-18 04:44Z), which set `@object-ui/plugin-grid` to `18.6.0`.
  - `git show 958ee0359:ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/listPageBarSlot.ts` fails ("exists on disk, but not in 958ee0359"). The 18.6.0 index exports neither symbol.
  - plugin-grid's `package.json` on `origin/main` still reads `18.6.0`. No "version packages" commit has landed since #33849.
  - #35637's own changeset, `.changeset/35554-list-no-actions-column.md`, is still pending on `main` and on this head, so no release has consumed it.
  - `git grep` on this head finds no remaining reference to `useListPageBarHost`, `ListPageBarState`, `listPageBarSlot` or `SelectionPageBar` outside prose.
  - The changeset's word "unpublished" is accurate. The face stays declaration and does not become narrowing.
- **Level** — `Metadata-protocol: none` takes `patch` (AGENTS.md, Post-Task Checklist step 3), including for a widening. The changeset bumps `patch` on all four packages whose published code the diff moves: plugin-grid, components, types and app-shell. Right. The examples, e2e and docs/qa paths publish nothing. Check Changeset is success on this head.
- The changeset has no migration section, and needs none: nothing published is removed or renamed.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Dev flags** — each answered or escalated:
  - Three i18n keys are no longer read (`grid.bulkAllOnPage`, `grid.bulkSelectAllMatching`, `grid.selectedAllLoaded`). Declared as a follow-up i18n card. Answered: removing them from 11 locale packs is its own change, and the keys the bar does read (`grid.selectedCount`, `grid.selectAllTotal`) exist in the packs, for example zh-Hans 「已选 N 条」 and 「选择全部 N 条」 (each with its count placeholder).
  - The local derived-gate run left `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` NOT-MEASURED. Answered: the check-runs on this head are the gate verdicts, and Build Core, Build UI Deps and the Type Check jobs are success.
  - Overlap with #35994 / #35983: reported clean, and nothing in the inputs contradicts it.
- **`open_questions`** — the PR carries none. The claim's seat-accepted readings are each honoured in the diff:
  - three actions or fewer are all buttons, Delete included;
  - over three, the first three non-delete actions are buttons and Delete goes last behind More;
  - the bar folds actions into More by measured width;
  - Esc is ignored while a field or another open layer has it;
  - the non-grid `ListView` strip is out of scope;
  - list pages have no phone bottom menu to replace.
- **F1 — should-fix, non-blocking.** The pending `.changeset/35554-list-no-actions-column.md` is unreleased and sits in the same plugin-grid release as this changeset. Several of its sentences are retired by this PR:
  - "a selection swaps the page bar";
  - "The first two are buttons … Delete is never a button";
  - "Grids outside a list page … keep … their bottom bulk bar";
  - "the page bar offers 「选择全部 M 条」".

  If nothing changes, plugin-grid's next CHANGELOG will publish both entries side by side, and they contradict each other on what a lone Delete is and on where the selection is shown. The AGENTS.md rule on correcting released entries does not apply yet, because that changeset is still unconsumed input. Fix either way: trim the four sentences from the pending 35554 changeset in this PR, or say in this changeset, in one line, that it supersedes them. Not a contract defect in the diff itself, so it does not change the verdict.
- **F2 — nit.** `floatingBar` is refused with `handlerKeyRefusal(..., 'runtime-slot')`. That helper's message calls the key "a RUNTIME SLOT for a host-supplied function" and talks about "handler key[s]" and authoring behaviour as a node type. That is inaccurate for a React-node slot. It is the same wording `summaryRow` already ships with, and it has no effect on correctness or on the contract.
- **F3 — nit, a disclosed reading, not escalated.**
  - Card item 7 reads 「选 1 条给单记录操作」. Outside the list page (child tabs, side record, embedded tables), one selected record gets the bulk actions, not its own. The PR body states this in 维护者速读 and in "One bar everywhere".
  - The claim's list of seat-accepted readings does not include it.
  - It holds against the card: those grids keep their row-end menu, so the record's own actions are still one click away, and this keeps the scoping #35554 set.
  - The seat should acknowledge it when it accepts the PR.
- **F4 — nit, not measured.** On a phone, the list page keeps its floating create button. The card's 375px acceptance item is measured only against overflow: the e2e checks `scrollWidth ≤ clientWidth`, a height of 44 and that the bar stays inside the window. Nothing checks for overlap with that button. The claim hands hiding "+" during selection to #35883. Until #35883 lands, whether the button sits on the bar at 375px is unmeasured. Record it on #35883, not here.
- **SQL push-down (Prime Directive 5)** — no finding.
  - The diff adds no query, no id materialisation and no in-app join.
  - `SelectionBar.tsx` and `listPageScope.ts` read only props and DOM.
  - The select-all-matching fan-out (`resolveBulkRows`, paged `find`, HARD_CAP 5000) is pre-existing and unchanged. Only its wording in the checklist doc moves.

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT (L1-b)

Head-sha: 957a7fa435e5238b61421c8e2df1a5c7d709ead7 · read 2026-11-21T08:12Z · full read of b89f1b5f..957a7fa4 (31 files, +1376/−993), card #35678 as rewritten 2026-11-20T23:00Z, claim 7058449261, PR body, and the browser screenshots kept with the card thread.

### 维护者速读

- 勾选行后，列表底部居中浮起一条小栏：「已选 N 条」和 ×，最多 3 个带文字的操作，其余进「更多」；只有一个操作（比如只有删除）时直接是按钮。页面顶部在勾选前后不再变化。卡上的验收项逐条都有对应的实现和测试。
- 主列表、记录页子表页签、侧边打开的记录、嵌入页面的表格用的是同一条栏；旧的贴底通栏和视图栏里的「已选」那一面都已删除，仓库里没有残留引用。
- 合计行仍然露在栏下面，选中期间列表末尾多留一段空白，最后一行能完整滚出来；浏览器测试量了位置。
- 不挡合并、建议补的两处：一是测试清单里还有一条步骤写着「选中后操作在视图栏右端」，测试人员照着会找错地方；二是「这是不是列表页」的登记方式比较脆，现在靠 React 的执行顺序才不出错，改成计数登记更稳。
- CI 在这个 head 上还在跑，L1 以绿灯为准。

### Must-fix

None.

### Should-fix

- **S1 — one checklist step still sends the tester to the retired face.** `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/records-forms.json` item `records-forms.list-view-capabilities` (revision 13), `steps[8]` (line 662 at this head): "…drops Mark Done from the selection actions the view bar's right end shows (since #35554 the list page has no bottom bulk bar; since #35878 the selection face is the view bar's right end, with ⋮ still last)…". After this PR the view bar does not change on selection, and those actions are in the floating bar. The PR updates `records-forms.bulk-select-all-matching` (rev 12) but not this item. Fix: reword the parenthetical to name the floating selection bar, bump the item to revision 14, and add a revisions entry with `"ref": "#35678"`.
- **S2 — the list-page scope registry drops a shared scope on the first unregister.** `listPageScope.ts` keys `scopes` by element (`Set<HTMLElement>`). Both `ObjectViewPageHeader` (`el.parentElement`) and `ObjectViewBarTrailing` (`closest([data-object-view-page-column])`) register the same page column, and `ObjectView.tsx:1294` unmounts the header the moment the trailing mounts (`!listBarHosted`). The header's cleanup `scopes.delete(X)` deletes the trailing's registration too. Today this works only because React runs the unmounted header's layout-effect cleanup (mutation phase) before the trailing's new layout effect (layout phase) in the same commit, so the trailing's add happens last. If the trailing's `pageColumn` resolves one commit earlier than `setHosted` lands, the scope disappears while the list is still on screen. The list then draws its Actions column again, and one selected record gets bulk actions instead of its own. The retired `listPageBarSlot.ts` did not have this problem, because each registration was its own `Host` object. Fix: count registrations (`Map<HTMLElement, number>`, delete at 0) or register a per-call token. A jsdom case that mounts two registrants of one element and unmounts one would pin it. The e2e on the real list page covers today's order only.

### Nits

- **N1** — The claim's file surface (7058449261) lists `data-table.tsx` as "one spacer row only". The diff also adds the `floatingBar` destructure and the sticky anchor (+16 lines). The PR body declares both, and they sit inside the renderer's existing tail region. Worth one line on the card if the seat keeps claim surfaces exact.
- **N2** — `SingleRecordActions` exposes only `def` and `edit` entries when a record offers more than three actions (`(entry) => entry.kind === 'def' || entry.kind === 'edit'`). Legacy `rowOperations` names never become buttons in that case, even when fewer than three entries are exposed. The bulk side admits legacy names (`!entry.destructive`). If this is intended, a one-line comment would say so. If not, admit `legacy` too.
- **N3** — Each mounted bar adds its own document `keydown` listener. Two grids with open selections on one page (for example two child tables) both clear on a single Esc. This is acceptable for now, and the card does not cover it.
- **N4** — `bottom-[calc(2.0625rem+1rem)]` mirrors the summary row's `h-8` + `border-t` by hand. A short comment naming that coupling would save the next person from measuring it. Also, while the spacer row is the last `tr`, `TableBody`'s `[&_tr:last-child]:border-0` no longer applies to the real last row, so that row gains a bottom border while rows are selected. This is harmless.
- **N5** — `useFittedCount`'s dependency-free layout effect reads `scrollWidth`/`clientWidth` on every bar render. That is cheap at this size; noted only.

### Checked

- **Card #35678, items 1–10 and the acceptance list.** One floating bar at the bottom centre of the list area (e2e measures the centre within ±1px). Up to three labelled actions, with the rest in 更多. A lone Delete is a button; over three, Delete goes behind 更多, last (`planExposedEntries`, unit cases for 3 vs 4+ and for Delete-only). The bar sits above the calc row (`bottom-[calc(…)]` when `summaryRow`; e2e checks bar bottom ≤ tfoot top), and the last row scrolls clear (spacer row `data-table-floating-bar-room`, `pb-16` on the card and grouped scrollers; e2e checks both). The page header is unchanged (both swap sites removed in `objectViewPageHeader.tsx`, and e2e checks `page-header` is visible). × and Esc clear. 「选择全部 N 条」 appears when every loaded row is selected and more match, with the #28552 cap strings kept on the chip text and title. The same bar draws on the table, card, grouped-card and grouped-table faces. Item 6 belongs to #35918; item 10 (context menu) is untouched, and its e2e case is kept. `Fixes` is right: the card's 「不做的」 puts kanban and the other views out of scope, and the claim records the phone reading (list pages draw no phone bottom menu).
- **Esc ownership.** The handler returns on `defaultPrevented`, on an editable target, or when another dialog, menu, listbox or popper is open and does not hold the bar. Radix layers `preventDefault` before they dismiss, so a menu's Esc never also clears. Unit cases cover the field and other-layer exceptions, and Esc inside the drawer that holds the bar.
- **Narrow width.** `useFittedCount` gives actions back to 更多 one at a time while `scrollWidth > clientWidth`, resets when the host width changes, and re-measures when the bar resizes. At fit 0 the More button still holds everything. The 375px screenshot shows the bar on one line with 批量更新 + 更多.
- **Clause-② widening.** `BulkActionBarProps` only gains the optional `singleRowMenu`; every old prop is kept with its type. `DataTableSchema.floatingBar?: React.ReactNode` is optional. The zod twin refuses it with `handlerKeyRefusal('floatingBar','runtime-slot',…)`, and the declared-keys and zod-parity tests are updated. `useListPageBarHost` / `ListPageBarState` / `useListPageBarSlot` came from the unreleased #35554 entry (`.changeset/35554-list-no-actions-column.md` is still pending at this head, and the claim records an `npm pack` read of 18.6.0 without them), so removing them narrows nothing published. All four touched published packages have changeset lines. l1-face flags `@object-ui/plugin-list`, which changes only `ListView.crossPageSelectAll.test.tsx` (no shipped file), so no entry is owed.
- **Retired faces leave no residue.** No source, test or e2e references to `SelectionPageBar`, `listPageBarSlot`, `useListPageBarHost`, `useListPageBarSlot`, `ListPageBarState` or `list-selection-page-bar` remain at this head. The i18n keys the bar reads (`grid.selectedCount`, `grid.selectAllTotal`, `grid.bulkClear`, `common.more`, the cap keys) exist in all 11 packs. The three keys that are no longer read are named in the PR body as a follow-up.
- **Styling.** No inline styles were added: the anchors, spacer and bar are utility classes only (`ui/AGENTS.md` Styling). In dark mode the bar has a `dark:border-foreground/20` edge, and the dark screenshot shows a visible edge.
- **Changeset text, sentence by sentence, against the code.** It matches: three exposed actions, Delete placement, sits above the calc row, room after the last row, the Select all offer, Esc exceptions, one bar on every face, one record offers its own actions only on the list page, the narrow fold, and the API lines. "Supersedes the selection behaviour in the list-page entry" is accurate against the pending #35554 entry.
- **README.** The new plugin-grid section matches the component and the `useListPageScope` contract.
- **Tests.** The rewrites are listed in the PR body as the card asks. The new unit cases match their names. The e2e covers the list page, child tab, side record, light/dark and 375px.

### Owed

- CI green at 957a7fa4 (34 checks pending at read time; at a05ec513 it was green, and a05ec513..957a7fa4 is changeset text only per the relay). The L1 is final on the green head.
- S1 and S2: on a later head I read only the delta.
- Follow-up card for the three unread i18n keys (`grid.bulkAllOnPage`, `grid.bulkSelectAllMatching`, `grid.selectedAllLoaded`), as the PR body says.
- L2 carry-forward is the seat's (declaration L2 7059675911 at a05ec513, Regen-provenance). This L1 does not replace it.

### 维护者速读

- 上一轮提的两处建议都已改好。测试清单里那条步骤现在写的是「底部浮出的操作条」，测试人员不会再去视图栏找。「是不是列表页」的登记改成了计数，页头和视图栏各登记一次，要两边都卸下才算离开列表页，不再依赖执行顺序。

### Checked

- **S2 closed.** `listPageScope.ts`: `scopes` is now `Map<HTMLElement, number>`. Register adds 1. The new `listPageScope-35678.test.tsx` mounts header, then both, then trailing only. That is the header-register → trailing-register → header-unmount order, which returns 'elsewhere' on the old `Set`: the old add was a no-op and the delete dropped the column. The thread reports the case red against the 957a7fa4 `listPageScope.ts` and green on this head.
- **S1 closed.** `records-forms.list-view-capabilities` `steps[8]` now names the floating selection bar and says the view bar does not change on selection. Revision 13 → 14, with a revisions entry `"ref": "#35678"` scoped to steps[8]. The rev-13 line changes only by its trailing comma.

- **Scope.** Nothing outside the S1/S2/N2/N4 lines changed. The changeset is untouched, and none is needed: the S2 fix is internal to an already-declared module.

### Owed

- CI green at f577149f. The L1 is final on the green head.
- The PR's base is still b89f1b5f while main is at eb53d63f. If the seat merges main before landing, I will read that merge-only delta.

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`

This is a delta round on the declaration face. Record 7059675911 reviewed `a05ec513` and was carried to `957a7fa4` by Regen-provenance. This round reviews `git diff 957a7fa4 pr-36021`, which is the single commit `f577149f0`. It changes 5 files (+94/−7):
